setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-note phrase through a MIDI device. The tempo is 130 BPM, the sequencer is stopped, the norns shows channel 1's Device screen and the PARAMS menu is closed. No trig params are assigned yet, so no CC values are sent.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4) and tap step 5 at (5,4) to extend the channel range to steps 1 to 5. Then on Channel tasks > Trig params assign CC 1 to a slot with E3 and K3, so steps can carry CC lock values. The phrase plays from the internal clock at 130 BPM.
steps.title: Assign CC 1 to a Trig params slot

steps.caption: On Trig params, hold each of steps 1, 3, 4 and 5 in turn and turn E3 to give it its own CC 1 lock value. Then tap K1 to open the norns PARAMS menu, choose MOSAIC and select Lock lead time (ms) in the Parameter locks section. Turn E3 to 0. At 0 each lock value is sent at the same moment as its step, together with the note. This is the original timing.
steps.title: Give steps CC values, set lead to 0

steps.caption: Close the menu and press Play (1,8), listen to the phrase and press Play again to stop. In the MIDI strip every CC 1 value sits at the same millisecond as its Note On.
steps.title: Hear it at 0 ms

steps.caption: Tap K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC > Lock lead time (ms) and set it to 25, the default. At 130 BPM each lock value will now leave about 29 ms before its step (25 ms rounded up to a whole clock pulse of 4.8 ms). The notes keep their exact times.
steps.title: Set 25 ms lead

steps.caption: Close the menu, press Play (1,8) and Stop. In the MIDI strip each CC 1 value now arrives about 29 ms before its Note On, which still falls at its usual time. A synth that smooths incoming CC changes has already reached the new value when the note starts.
steps.title: Hear it at 25 ms

steps.caption: Tap K1, reopen Lock lead time (ms) and set it to 50. At 130 BPM lock values will leave about 53 ms (11 pulses) ahead of their step, and the notes still sound at their usual times. Use the larger lead for slow filters or effects that need longer to settle.
steps.title: Set 50 ms lead

steps.caption: Close the menu, press Play (1,8) and Stop. In the MIDI strip each CC 1 value arrives about 53 ms before its Note On, so the change lands before the note rather than gliding through it. The notes do not move.
steps.title: Hear it at 50 ms

title: Send lock values before their notes
